prompt: Build a Python CLI that reads a UTF-8 file. Do not use external dependencies. Include tests.
text:
Objective:
Create a Python command-line interface (CLI) that reads a UTF-8 file.

Constraints:
-. No use of external dependencies.
-. The CLI should be able to read UTF-8 files.
.
Implementation Phases:
-. Design the CLI structure.
-. Implement the functionality to read a UTF-8 file.
-. Test the CLI.
.
Tests:
-. Test that the CLI can read a UTF a UTF-8 file.
-. Test that the CLI can handle non-ASCII errors when reading a UTF-8 file.
-. Test that the CLI can handle a wide of of characters when reading a UTF-8 file.
.

Acceptance Criteria:
-. The CLI should not use any external dependencies.
-. The CLI should successfully read and display the contents of a UTF-8 file.
